import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the iris dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Melt the dataframe to prepare it for plotting
melted_data = pd.melt(data, id_vars=['species'], value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'])

# Create a boxplot to visualize the distribution of sepal and petal measurements
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.boxplot(x='variable', y='value', hue='species', data=melted_data)

# Set axis labels, title, and legend
plt.title('Distribution of Sepal and Petal Measurements by Species')
plt.xlabel('Measurement Type')
plt.ylabel('Value')
plt.legend(title='Species')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
